name: code-atlas
description: Code Atlas —— 把任意代码库扫成一份可读的中间数据（bundle），供人探索、供 AI 查询

scripts.publish:sc: node tools/build-payload.mjs && dotnet publish launcher/CodeAtlas.Launcher.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -p:CodeAtlasEdition=full -p:CodeAtlasPayload=payload.zip -o publish-sc
scripts.publish:lite: node tools/build-payload.mjs --no-node && dotnet publish launcher/CodeAtlas.Launcher.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:CodeAtlasEdition=lite -p:CodeAtlasPayload=payload-lite.zip -o publish-lite
scripts.publish: npm run publish:sc && npm run publish:lite
